description: Searches locally owned places in Milwaukee County by meaning, for example "friday fish fry with perch" or "frozen custard on the south side". Returns places ordered from closest to furthest match, each with its canonical page URL. Filters by category, neighborhood, tags (every tag must match) and kind. Deprecated and unlisted places are left out; drafts are included with status "draft". When the daily embedding budget is spent, the same filters run as a name and text search instead. A tag outside the vocabulary returns { "error": "invalid_input" }.

category.description: Only places in this category slug, for example fish-fry. list_categories returns the slugs.

kind.description: Only places of this kind: place (a business or public place) or organization (a group or company).

limit.description: How many places to return, default 10; values above 50 return 50.

neighborhood.description: Only places in this neighborhood slug, for example bay-view.

query.description: What the person is looking for, in plain words.

tags.description: Only places that carry every one of these tag slugs, as a list or one comma-separated string, for example patio,live-music. list_tags returns the vocabulary.

name: search_places
